decisions.reason: Devore decoration fabrics follow design trends and often rotate out of collections after about three years, but the firm's promise of reorder continuity argues for keeping it a while longer.
Transparent burnout sheers are fashion-driven and at risk of collection replacement, yet they remain close to the core offer and can still serve reorders from stock.
This burnout fabric overlaps with the other devore and burnout items, so it is a candidate for consolidation, but continuity for retail customers favours keeping it for now.
Velour-like upholstery fabrics are durable staples with steady demand in retail and contract markets, which fits the firm's in-stock model.
Flame-retardant plain inbetween fabrics are functional basics needed for contract buyers and rarely go out of fashion.
Polyester satin lining is a basic complementary article that supports the made-to-measure sewing service and has stable demand.
